content: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services immediately by dialing 911. If the situation is less urgent, contact a poison control center right away. In the United States, you can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222, and in Canada, you can call 1-844-764-7669. While taking this medication, your doctor may recommend laboratory or medical tests, such as kidney function tests or blood mineral level assessments, to monitor your health. It is important to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. For storage, follow the instructions provided on the product's packaging. If you have any questions about proper storage, consult your pharmacist. Do not freeze the medication, and avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, discard it properly. This information was last updated in May 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your individual health needs.
